idle_tunnel.name: vault999
idle_tunnel.status: IDLE — BY DESIGN. VAULT999 is internal only. Public proof surface is /999 on main site.
idle_tunnel.note: Do NOT activate. This is intentional. VAULT999 has no public proxy.

ingress_routes._pattern: Cloudflare Tunnel → https://127.0.0.1:443 → Caddy → internal service
ingress_routes._note: All tunnel ingress routes point to Caddy on localhost:443. Caddy does the actual routing by domain name.

hermes_direct_http.note: This route goes DIRECT to :8090 (HTTP) instead of through Caddy HTTPS. This is an exception — the Hermes gateway may not have TLS configured internally. Low risk since traffic is already encrypted by Cloudflare Tunnel.

dual_path_clarification._note: Most domains have TWO paths to reach them:
dual_path_clarification.path_1: DNS → Cloudflare CDN → VPS :443 → Caddy → organ
dual_path_clarification._why: Path 1 handles normal web traffic. Path 2 provides an additional tunnel for regions where direct connection is blocked/slow. Both terminate at Caddy.
